summary: Implementation phase. Adds the first official Runtime CLI inspection command, pcae runtime inspect, exposing 111B's observation-only Runtime Introspection model as a safe, read-only operational snapshot. No runtime behavior change, no plugin loading/instantiation/invocation, no Permission Broker evaluation, no execution capability. Adds src/pcae/commands/runtime_inspect.py and wires a new runtime inspect subcommand (sibling to the existing runtime snapshot family) into src/pcae/cli.py, supporting --json and --verbose. Constructs one fresh, empty RuntimeRegistry() per invocation (no persistence exists anywhere in this codebase, per 110E) and calls all eight 111B get_*() functions against it. Human output is eleven labeled lines, not a raw dict dump; --verbose adds full plugin metadata, capability declarations across all ten frozen classes, the four INT-NNN observation integration entries (109C), and a current-limitations section. --json output has eight top-level keys (runtime, registry, plugins, capabilities, health, governance, state, version), verified stable/deterministic across invocations. PluginDescriptor.manifest (open, untyped field) is deliberately excluded from all output modes -- verified directly with a planted manifest key that never appears anywhere in the serialized snapshot. Safety verified directly: no mutation (repeat snapshot calls produce identical results, registry state unchanged before/after); no PermissionBroker.evaluate() call, confirmed via an AST-based call-site check (not a substring search, since the module's own docstring legitimately names PermissionBroker.evaluate() in prose to explain what it deliberately never does); no plugin loading/instantiation/invocation (source scan plus always-empty live output); no subprocess/network/file-write/environment-variable access; module import isolation via an AST-based allowlist restricting the module to argparse, json, and three already-frozen internal modules. Compatibility verified: runtime_introspection.py (111B) unmodified; runtime_registry.py (110E/110F) remains metadata-only; command_path_observation.py (109C) still exactly 4 INT-NNN entries; Permission Broker decisions still execution_unavailable (live re-check); existing pcae health/pcae check still run to completion, unaffected. Added docs/PHASE_111_RUNTIME_INSPECT_CLI.md. docs/ROADMAP.md evaluated and found to need no change. 46 new tests (tests/test_runtime_inspect_cli.py), using this repo's established in-process pcae.cli.main() + capsys CLI-testing pattern rather than subprocess invocation. Focused tests (638), governance/autonomy group (2111), and the release/lifecycle regression subset actually present (1429/1429, excluding the two known-slow phase85/phase87 integration files) all passed under -n auto; fast_green 4390/4390 (matches documented baseline).
